stage_i.scope: Typed original-game conventions, building-block logical properties and SSA composition only

clauses.property: One R,C in [0,1]^(m*n); all strategies in original full simplices; U(x,y)=x^T U y
u_R(y) has a full-simplex universal upper bound and an attained equality; mirror for u_C(x)
clauses.forbidden_change: One common existential attainer cannot serve every opponent

clauses.property: f_R=u_R-R; f_C=u_C-C; F=max(f_R,f_C); repeated terms and mixed strategies share same payoff function

rho*y_s_1 and sigma*y_s_2 are nonnegative dual vectors supported in the delta_f-nearBR row and column sets, with total masses rho and sigma and rho+sigma=1; zero-mass returned y_s_1 or y_s_2 is arbitrary typed strategy
clauses.zero_mass: y_s_1 or y_s_2 arbitrary typed strategy, no nearBR/alignment assertion

clauses.property: same enlarged primal feasibility for every nearBR row and column
Phi_1,Phi_2 are stationary LP offsets satisfying the raw dual constraints over full original x,y
raw_dual_constraints: Phi_1<=-rho*R(x,x_s_2)+sigma*(C(x,y_s_2)-C(x,x_s_2)) for every x in full row simplex
Phi_2<=-sigma*C(x_s_1,y)+rho*(R(y_s_1,y)-R(x_s_1,y)) for every y in full column simplex

clauses.property: primal h upper-bounds all row deviations at y_x and exact column regret
quantifier_order: forall x_1_prime in full row simplex

clauses.property: eta*(R(y_1_1,y)-R(x,y))+(1-eta)*(u_C(x)-C(x,y))>=h for every original y; same primal-dual value; h=F(x,y_x)<=F(x,y)
quantifier_order: forall y in full column simplex

clauses.property: d=eta*y_1_1,sum d=eta; conditional BR alignment and player-value complementarity
quantifier_order: if eta>0 then forall x_1_prime BR comparison
clauses.zero_mass: y_1_1 arbitrary; no unconditional BR alignment

clauses.property: mirror primal full-domain constraints and optimal value
quantifier_order: forall k in full column simplex

clauses.property: (1-xi)*(u_R(y)-R(x,y))+xi*(C(x,y_1_2)-C(x,y))>=h for every original x; xi is column mass
quantifier_order: forall x in full row simplex

clauses.property: e=xi*y_1_2,sum e=xi; conditional BR alignment and player-value complementarity
quantifier_order: if xi>0 then forall k BR comparison
clauses.zero_mass: y_1_2 arbitrary; no unconditional BR alignment

clauses.property: x_o in conv(x_s_1,y_s_1),y_o in conv(x_s_2,y_s_2); F(x_o,y_o)<=F((1-p)x_s_1+p*y_s_1,(1-q)x_s_2+q*y_s_2)+tau for every p,q in [0,1]
clauses.ideal: tau=0 is true global product-hull minimum
clauses.forbidden_change: boundary-edge optimizer replacing global hull primitive

clauses.ideal: follows from O01 with tau=0 at the four corners
clauses.implementation: return a minimizer on a rational coefficient grid containing 0 and 1 in each coordinate; holds exactly even for tau>0

clauses.property: output belongs to five actual profiles [first4,O] and has F no greater than every list member
